name: Shasta College – Trinity Campus
description: Community college satellite campus offering general education courses, career technical programs, GED/HiSET prep, college transfer programs, and workforce training for Trinity County residents. Financial aid and counseling available.

name: Trinity County Office of Education – HiSET & GED
description: Adult basic education, GED/HiSET prep, English as a Second Language (ESL) classes, and workforce readiness training in partnership with Shasta College and regional adult education consortium.

name: Trinity County Behavioral Health Services
description: Mental health and substance use disorder assessments, therapy (individual/group), case management, medication services, youth/adolescent treatment, outpatient and crisis services.

name: Milestones Wellness Center
description: Peer support drop-in center for adults, offering social connection, life-skills groups (e.g., yoga, crafts, WRAP), basic needs assistance, and referrals to other services.

name: Trinity County Public Health
description: WIC; immunizations; communicable disease control; maternl/chil-d/adolescent health; oral health; CHDP; lead & injury prevention; opioid safety; vital records.

description: Outpatient treatment, recovery support, individual/group counseling, perinatal

name: Regional Workforce Development Referrals
